summary: SAML entityID mismatch for provisioned service user blocks internal analytics portal login
description:
Issue summary: A provisioned service account (svc-analytics-ingest) can no longer complete SAML SSO for the internal Analytics Portal. Attempts to sign in redirect back to the IdP and show a generic 'authentication failed' banner. Not all users are affected; interactive user logins succeed. Impact: Engineering and data teams cannot access internal dashboards that rely on the service account for scheduled report generation; alerts dependent on the account are failing. Scope appears limited to service principals created before the IdP migration on 2026-02-28.

Environment: prod-us-west (internal-analytics.redwood.company). IdP: Okta tenant rwd-prod; SAML SP: analytics-portal (entityID: https://analytics.redwood.company/saml/metadata).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Attempt to initiate SSO for svc-analytics-ingest via scheduled job or manual federation flow using the service account's SSO cookie.
2) IdP receives SAML AuthnRequest, returns SAMLResponse to SP endpoint.
3) SP rejects assertion and redirects to IdP with no clear error in UI.

Observed behavior:
- SP logs show: "SAMLResponse rejected: audience/issuer mismatch: expected 'https://analytics.redwood.company/saml/metadata' got 'analytics-portal'"
- Okta audit shows successful assertion issuance for svc-analytics-ingest at 2026-03-12T14:02:11Z.
- Only service principals provisioned prior to 2026-02-28 are affected; newly-provisioned service principals authenticate normally.

Expected behavior: Assertions for provisioned service users should be accepted when the configured SP entityID aliases are present.

Temporary workaround: Manual alias mapping added in the SP config (identity proxy) allows the affected jobs to authenticate; workaround requires platform ops intervention and is not persisted across proxy rolling restarts.

Notes: This ticket ties to recent IdP migration tasks and the internal identity proxy changes rolled out 2026-02-28. We suspect a normalization/legacy-entity mapping was dropped during the migration, causing older service accounts that reference legacy entityIDs to fail audience checks.

investigation_notes:
Checked SP logs (/var/log/identity-proxy/analytics-saml.log): repeated 'audience/issuer mismatch' errors at assertion timestamp.
Stacktrace excerpt: SAMLAssertionValidator#validateAudience -> AudienceNotMatchException: expected 'https://analytics.redwood.company/saml/metadata' got 'analytics-portal'

Pulled Okta assertion for svc-analytics-ingest via Okta system log (OKTA-ev-44112). Assertion Issuer field contains 'analytics-portal' (legacy short name) for pre-migration accounts. New accounts use the full entityID URL.

Compared identity-proxy config snapshots: pre-migration (2026-02-20) included 'entity_aliases: ["analytics-portal"]' under analytics-portal SP. Post-migration snapshot (2026-02-28) lacks entity_aliases for several SPs due to a conditional branch in the config generator that skipped aliasing when 'service_type' == 'legacy'.
Reproduced the failure locally by crafting a SAMLResponse with Issuer 'analytics-portal' against the current proxy; proxy rejected assertion. After adding alias, assertion accepted.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied: Temporary alias added to identity-proxy for analytics-portal to accept legacy issuer names; restored scheduled reports.

Permanent fix: Identity team preparing PR to change config generator to preserve entity_aliases for legacy service principals and to run a one-time migration script to reconcile SP configs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/identity/pull/879 (in review).

Follow-ups: 1) Run reconciliation job across prod regions to re-add missing aliases and validate SAML flows for all pre-migration service principals. 2) Add unit/integration test to config generator to prevent regression. 3) Document migration checklist that includes verifying entity_alias preservation.
Estimated timeline: PR merge + staged rollout targeted for 2026-03-16; full verification post-rollout by 2026-03-17.
